title: Itrone Eyahamba Ngephanyazo
intro: Umntu owayenegunya elikhulu walawula ubukumkani obutyebileyo obusikelelwe ngobutyebi obungenakulinganiswa. Xa kwavela umngeni ongalindelekanga, lo mlawuli wajongana novavanyo olungelulo lwamakrele kodwa lobulumko nokholo. Okwenzekayo kwakuza kukhokelela ukusuka kwincopho yamandla ehlabathi ukuya kutshintsho olukhulu lwentliziyo.
clues: Ndalawula ubukumkani obusikelelwe ngobutyebi nempumelelo engaphaya kokucingelwa
Ndandingukumkani onamandla owafumana ileta enesibindi efuna ukuzithoba
Izikhulu zam zandicebisa malunga nokuba ndilwe okanye ndenze uxolo nalo kumkani ukude.
Ndaphuma nezipho ezintle kakhulu ukuze ndidibane nalo kumkani ukude nam
Itrone yam yobukhosi yaziswa kwilizwe elikude ngokuphanyaza kweliso, ngaphambi kokuba ndibuye
Ndathi ndakungena ebhotwe elinomgangatho ogudileyo njengeglasi, ekugqibeleni ndavakalisa ukuzithoba kwam ku-Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
